text:
nora (PM): Hey team, design review for Deployments & Rollouts UI. Main asks: timeline scrubber affordances, canary scheduler UX, A/B variant labels, and rollback confirmation flows. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc-rollout-v2. Please flag accessibility and copy.

deploy-bot: Staging preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/rollouts/8433 (build #8433) :eyes:

dave (Design): Proto has a horizontal timeline with draggable scrubber. Concern: on narrow screens the tick labels overlap. Proposal: compress into stacked lanes when width < 900px. Also add a subtle shadow on the scrubber to aid discoverability. Copy: replace generic "Rollback" with tiered language: "Rollback (major)" / "Rollback (minor)".

rita (FE): Stacked lanes makes sense. For the scrubber, using pointer events + keyboard is fine but we should announce scrubber position to AT via aria-live politely (role="status"). Also prefer incremental keyboard adjustments: arrows 1%, PageUp/PageDown 10%, Home/End to go to start/end.

ada (Accessibility): Please ensure the scrubber thumb has at least 44px hit target. Tick labels are currently 3:1 contrast — bump to 4.5:1. Also tooltips must be reachable by keyboard and have visible focus rings. For the traffic-slices chart, use both color and pattern (diagonal lines/dots) and provide textual legend.

omar (Platform): A/B variants: we should show stable identifiers plus experiment link. Suggest label format: "variant: blue-button (v4 • 0a9c)" and a small link icon to open the experiment metrics. Also surface the active model hash for reproducibility.

tia (SRE): Rollback behavior needs to mention session affinity and streaming requests. Proposed microcopy for confirm dialog: 
```
Header: Confirm rollback to v3
Body: New requests will be routed to v3. Ongoing streaming sessions may continue on current instances. This action is irreversible for 2 minutes while traffic drains.
Fields: Reason (optional) | Force-terminate active sessions (checkbox)
Buttons: Cancel | Confirm rollback (requires typing the tag: v3)
```
I prefer typing the tag (short string) over the full commit hash to reduce friction. For major infra changes we can require full hash.

dave (Design): Good call. UX idea: show a small inline timeline preview inside the modal (2-3 ticks) to help users see immediate impact. For the "irreversible" wording maybe soften: "This will start rollback and may take N minutes to complete." Avoid absolute words unless true.

rita (FE): Implementation note: lazy-load diffs only when user clicks "Show diff" to avoid payload bloat. Diffs should be syntax-highlighted and support copy-to-clipboard. Also add an aria-describedby id for the confirm input error state.

ada (Accessibility): For copy-to-clipboard confirm, ensure we provide live-region feedback: "Copied commit hash to clipboard". Also the modal's destructive button should have aria-atomic so screen readers read the updated state after confirmation.

omar (Platform): Scheduling canary: allow users to chain steps (percent + duration). Suggest preset templates: Quick Ramp, Conservative Ramp, Manual Control. Show estimated impacted RPS per step based on recent traffic. Include ability to cancel schedule.

tia (SRE): Audit: every change in the timeline needs an actor, timestamp, and reason (if provided). Add a small "Export audit" button. CSV columns example: time,user,action,from,to,reason,node_list.

dave (Design): Microcopy tweaks: change header from "Rollouts" to "Deployments & rollouts" for clarity. Replace label "canary" with "canary rollout" in CTAs. Add a help tooltip next to scheduler: "What does this do?" -> 2-line explanation + link to docs.

rita (FE): Keyboard focus order is key: timeline scrubber -> step details -> action buttons. I'll prototype tabindex flow and post a draft PR.

ada (Accessibility): Also add focus-visible styles for all interactive elements. For colorblind patterns, test with DeskPro simulators.

nora (PM): Action items: 1) Design: stacked-lane responsive timeline + modal preview (dave). 2) FE: keyboard scrubbing, lazy diffs, clipboard/live-region feedback (rita). 3) Platform: variant IDs, metrics links, schedule presets (omar). 4) SRE: audit export schema + session-affinity notes (tia). 5) Accessibility: contrast, hit targets, focus-visible (ada). I'll open tickets and assign owners.

deploy-bot: Preview updated: https://preview.redwood.ai/rollouts/8434 (build #8434) :white_check_mark:

dave (Design): I'll upload a compact timeline variant and two modal flows (type-to-confirm vs checkbox) to Figma by EOD.

rita (FE): I'll add keyboard interaction PR targeting the scrubber and slider tomorrow morning. cc @ada for review.

omar (Platform): I'll scope the API changes for audit export and variant metadata.

tia (SRE): I'll document the recommended rollback wording and the 2-minute drift window with ops runbook.

ada (Accessibility): Happy with plan. Will run a quick keyboard-only pass once PR lands.

nora (PM): Thanks everyone! We'll reconvene after PR + Figma updates.

dave (Design): LGTM :sparkles:

rita (FE): ack
